# Free Omni Tools

> Free online tools that run 100% in the browser   no sign-up, no uploads, no tracking. 251 real tools across PDF, Word, image, video & audio, SEO, developer, AI, social media, student and everyday calculators, published in five languages: English (/en), Spanish (/es), French (/fr), Arabic (/ar, right-to-left) and Russian (/ru). Every page exists under each locale prefix; swap the prefix to read the same page in another language.
